name: Propizepine
summary: Propizepine (brand names Depressin, Vagran) is a tricyclic antidepressant (TCA) used in France for the treatment of depression which was introduced in the 1970s.

uses.text: Propizepine (brand names Depressin, Vagran) is a tricyclic antidepressant (TCA) used in France for the treatment of depression which was introduced in the 1970s.

sideEffects.en: Little is recorded about it specifically. Tricyclic antidepressants as a group cause dry mouth, constipation, drowsiness, blurred vision and dizziness on standing. Overdose is dangerous and can cause seizures and fatal heart rhythm problems.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它本身的紀錄不多。三環抗憂鬱藥整體而言會引起口乾、便秘、嗜睡、視力模糊和起身頭暈。過量很危險，可能導致癲癇發作和致命的心律問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它本身的纪录不多。三环抗忧郁药整体而言会引起口干、便秘、嗜睡、视力模糊和起身头晕。过量很危险，可能导致癫痫发作和致命的心律问题。

fact.en: Propizepine is one of several tricyclic antidepressants that were sold mainly in France and never reached the English-speaking world.
fact.zh: Propizepine 是幾種主要在法國販售、從未進入英語國家市場的三環抗憂鬱藥之一。
fact.zhHans: Propizepine 是几种主要在法国贩售、从未进入英语国家市场的三环抗忧郁药之一。
